description: Paid transaction preflight. Checks mandate, amount, destination, merchant, expiry and replay risk before an autonomous payment executes. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base.

agent.description: Optional caller agent metadata. Assertions are advisory unless independently verified.

signature_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that the agent signature was verified before this preflight.

authorization.description: Caller-provided payment authorization boundary used for advisory comparison.

allowed_domains.description: Optional allowlist of merchant domains authorized for this payment.

expected_recipient.description: Optional recipient required by the authorization boundary; compared with the requested payment recipient.

human_confirmed.description: Whether the caller asserts that required human confirmation has occurred.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount authorized by the caller mandate.

merchant.description: Merchant identity and optional recipient expectation.

domain.description: Merchant domain the payment is intended for.

expected_recipient.description: Optional merchant-side expected payment recipient for cross-checking.

payment.description: Payment facts to compare with the caller authorization envelope.

amount.description: Requested payment amount in the caller contract units.

currency.description: Payment asset or currency symbol, for example USDC.

network.description: Payment network identifier, for example eip155:8453 for Base.

recipient.description: Destination account or address that would receive the payment.

name: verify_agent_payment_intent
title: Verify Agent Payment Intent
